column2: Nothing in this Part of this Act shall limit or affect
a fine imposed on a company whether before or after
the  commencement  of  the  winding  up  of  the
company, for the commission of an offence;
a monetary penalty payable to the State imposed on
a company by a court whether before or after the
commencement of the winding up of the company,
for the breach of any enactment;
costs ordered to be paid by the company in relation
to proceedings for the offence or breach; or
all provident fund dues, employees trust fund dues
